FeatureTracker.type: class FeatureTracker { constructor( readonly rect: PlayRect, readonly aspect: number, readonly settings: Settings, readonly pointer: PointerKind, ); push(tSeconds: number, hand: DetectedHand | null):; { const graceS = this.settings.graceMs / 1000; if (hand === null) return this.mainAbsente(tSeconds, graceS); const brut = rawFeatures(hand, this.rect, this.aspect, this.pointer); return this.filtrer(tSeconds, brut); } private mainAbsente(tSeconds: number, graceS: number):; { const dernier = this.etat.dernier; if (dernier === null) return { smooth: VIDE, fast: VIDE }; const dansLaGrace = this.etat.dernierT !== null && tSeconds - this.etat.dernierT <= graceS; const tenu: Features = { ...dernier, present: dansLaGrace, speedU: 0, speedV: 0 }; return { smooth: tenu, fast: tenu }; } private filtrer(tSeconds: number, brut: Features):; { const precedent = this.etat.vifPrecedent; const pas = precedent === null || this.etat.dernierT === null ? 0 : tSeconds - this.etat.dernierT; const lisse = {} as Record<Grandeur, number>; const vif = {} as Record<Grandeur, number>; for (const g of GRANDEURS) { const canaux = this.etat.canaux[g]; lisse[g] = canaux.smooth.filter(brut[g], tSeconds); vif[g] = canaux.fast.filter(brut[g], tSeconds); } if (pas > 0 && precedent !== null) { this.etat.vitesseU = (vif.u - precedent.u) / pas; this.etat.vitesseV = (vif.v - precedent.v) / pas; } this.etat.vifPrecedent = { u: vif.u, v: vif.v }; this.etat.dernierT = tSeconds; const smooth: Features = { ...lisse, speedU: this.etat.vitesseU, speedV: this.etat.vitesseV, present: true, edge: brut.edge }; this.etat.dernier = smooth; const fast: Features = { ...vif, speedU: this.etat.vitesseU, speedV: this.etat.vitesseV, present: true, edge: brut.edge }; return { smooth, fast }; } reset(): void }
